text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Post time is finally upon us for
the Spring Grand Prix race, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
First, the odd-numbered Umamusume
are gradually beginning to enter the gates—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's... starting...
It's starting...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Th-The tension is incredible...!
My chest... my throat is tightening up...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Puha...!!
*Inhaaale*, *exhaaale*, *inhaaale*...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "All Umamusume are now in the gates. Everything is set—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is underway!
And so, the Takarazuka Kinen that I watched with bated breath alongside Rhein Kraft was—

...To be honest, it was over in the blink of an eye.
Just over two minutes. It happened in a flash.
Yet in that fleeting instant, the little witch—
The barrier of decades of history has been shattered.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere from the outside, it's Sweep Tosho!
It's Sweep Tosho, Number 11!
Sweep Tosho makes a furious charge from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh, yaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhh---!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho, it's Sweep Tosho!
Sweep Tosho claims victory
in the Takarazuka Kinen!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming last year's champion, the race favorite Tap Dance City!
And even defeating Zenno Rob Roy,
who achieved the Senior Autumn Triple Crown as only the second in history!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho takes a commanding first place!
This Umamusume is—strong...!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Ah—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...
A Tiara horse girl just conquered the Takarazuka Kinen...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And she did it against a field of powerhouse Umamusume who defined an entire era...!
Th-This... This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!
Incredible, Sweep Toshoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ah... it's magic.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (History has changed.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Common sense has been turned completely upside down.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's magic.
Sweep-san's magic...!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (The future for Tiara Umamusume has expanded... once again—!)
...Moreover.
And just one week later—

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Commanding the lead!! Cesario enters
the final straight out in front!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Cesario takes the lead and pulls even further away from the pack! Maintaining a three-length lead, she crosses under 200 meters to go!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Cesario, Cesario!!
There's no way Cesario loses this now!
A lead of four, five lengths!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"...Cesaarrriioooo!!
Cesario did it!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Incredible……!!

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The winning time is 1 minute 59.03 seconds!
Without slowing down a bit,
she crosses the finish line in a solo runaway!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's Tiara Umamusume, Cesario!!
For the first time in history, a Japanese Umamusume has conquered an American G1!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario...!!
She did it! Amazing, amazing, amazing, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You're amazing... Cesario...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's opening up!! It's changing!!
It's expanding—...!!
More and more, constantly reborn!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(With our own hands!
The future of Tiara Umamusume will—!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Cesario!?
Yeah, I was watching... I watched the whole thing!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, yeah, I was totally mesmerized!
It was amazing. ...You looked so cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cesario!
Congratulations. You really showed us what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case, go ahead and enjoy LA to the fullest
as a celebration! I'll send you my recommended
burger joints later.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And recharge your energy properly
before making your triumphant return to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Our race with each other
is only just getting started!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as Heart-san says!
We'll be waiting here. See you later, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: They will achieve great things.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I, uh—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
(Pitter-patter...)
(Thud)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry,
Shakur-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch.
Quit lookin' down at the ground while ya walk."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... I am terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?
...Hey, you—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry.
Excuse me...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Such a stubborn, straightforward fool.
